gen-dafont-origami-gf-ruda: Approachable from the first glance, Origami draws brush-sign letters at constant width with a heavy, lead-type lowercase. Ruda follows in a plain sans with a sizable x-height and wide-mouthed rounds, so the page moves from loud to easy.
gen-dafont-origami-gf-saira: Brush-sign strokes, heavy as poured lead. Saira, in sans-serif form, lets you see through each s, and if Origami were made small, its dense lowercase would clog quickly.
gen-dafont-origami-gf-sarpanch: Cord-thick curves, brush-sign swagger. Origami hits hard up top, while Sarpanch, a plain sans, keeps its lowercase e clearly open and its lines compact, so a long passage moves along without snagging.
gen-dafont-origami-gf-savate: Savate opens with tall, rounded o shapes that nearly match its capital O. Origami does best as one steady squeezed line of brush-sign weight, while Savate does best with fuller stems and slimmer links.
gen-dafont-origami-gf-sen: Sen reads tall and modern, a plain sans tracing each letter in one constant line, curves stopping before they turn inward. And its size can stay generous, since that tall lowercase gives Origami's heavy brush-sign headline something lighter to stand against.
gen-dafont-origami-gf-sofia-sans-semi-co: Origami looks like a sign-painter's brush dragged at constant width, with a lowercase as dense as lead type. And it earns its keep big and short, leaving Sofia Sans Semi Condensed, a plain sans, to handle the text.
gen-dafont-origami-gf-stack-sans-headlin: Origami's single-stroke brush line never changes width, and its lowercase looks poured from lead. Stack Sans Headline does the quieter work in sans-serif, with wide gaps that keep tiny sizes crisp.
gen-dafont-origami-gf-stack-sans-text: Origami's brush-sign stroke holds one width, with a lowercase like poured lead. Stack Sans Text, a plain sans with big-bodied letters and curve endings kept apart, is the pair's strongest quality: a loud heading beside a marker-like line.
gen-dafont-origami-gf-sulphur-point: Poured-lead lowercase, brush-sign line. Origami and Sulphur Point share a marker-like steadiness, and the pair's strongest quality is how that sans keeps its open gaps distinct beneath a bulky display heading.
gen-dafont-origami-gf-tiktok-sans: Origami draws every stroke with a pipe-like body, brush-sign style, in a lowercase like poured lead. And TikTok Sans, a modern sans with x-height near cap height, is the pair's strongest quality: heavy and lean, side by side.
